evals.expected_output: A markdown report with 🔴/🟡/🟢 severity sections identifying at minimum: epoch_ms_to_datetime dead function, fix-narrative docstrings in cache.py/search.py, and the 'Full-text search' mislabeled docstring.

Report flags at least one fix-narrative docstring (contains 'original blueprint' or similar historical language)

Report includes suggested fixes or next steps for each finding

evals.prompt: Find all unused functions, commented-out code blocks, and TODO/FIXME/HACK markers in src/claude_history_mcp/. For each TODO/marker, evaluate whether it's still actionable or should be removed. Run vulture or ruff if available.
evals.expected_output: A report listing dead code, zombie code, and TODO markers with actionable assessments. At minimum: epoch_ms_to_datetime dead function, and context for any markers found.
expectations: Report identifies 'epoch_ms_to_datetime' as unused dead code
Report checks for commented-out code blocks (zombie code)
Report evaluates each marker's actionability (still needed vs stale)
Report attempts to use vulture or ruff for automated dead code detection
